title: The Trident: A Minimum Symmetric Clause Gadget for 3SAT to 3-Coloring (code and logs)
description: Enumeration program in Lean 4 and logs for the trident clause gadget. The repository also holds the logs of the authors' original enumeration program, the smallest asymmetric gadgets with a short program that checks them, and a formal verification in Lean 4, which is under evaluation by the authors.
